newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: HBG BUYS MAJORITY OF CZECH CONSULTANCY.
newsitem.headline: HBG BUYS MAJORITY OF CZECH CONSULTANCY.

text.p: Construction firm Hollandsche Beton Groep NV (HBG) said on Tuesday its consultancy unit Tebodin had taken an unspecified majority stake in engineering consultancy Projekta s.r.o. in the Czech Republic.
HBG had also been awarded an option to expand the interest at a later date, the largest Dutch builder said in a statement.
Projekta has 125 employees and has been cooperating with HBG's Tebodin for some time in various projects.
The takeover fits Tebodin's policy to expand activities in central and east Europe, HBG said. No financial details were disclosed.
